description: The agent must: (1) Read books_meta.json and each book's daily JSON from input_data/. (2) Compute creation cost using the exact formula: cost = word_count × (time_per_thousand_words_hours / 1000) × hourly_rate, then ROI = total_revenue / cost — yielding book_001=1.5, book_002≈0.667 (loss), book_003=1.1, book_004≈1.583. (3) Grade each book's last-day metrics against SKILL.md's 合格线/优秀线 thresholds for 完读率(45%/60%), 追读率(30%/50%), 评分(8.0/9.0), 日均收入(100/500). (4) Detect anomalies using exact rules: book_001's reads dropped from 55000 to 33000 (−40%, exceeds the >30% drop threshold → 数据暴跌 alert); book_003's last-day revenue of 650 exceeds 2× the 6-day average (~154.67 × 2 = 309.33 → 收入异常 alert). (5) Output all results into book_performance_report.json with structured alert objects containing type fields, ensuring no false alerts for stable books like book_004.
